construction: 46 parts in 9 steps. Courses of bricks and plates lie on their sides (steps 1–8); 1×1 bricks with a stud on one side hold them (steps 3, 5 and 7). Step 9: two identical `Step 118` children finish the slab.
lesson: An edge-on plate mosaic: bricks and plates laid on their sides show their edges as a high-resolution flat pattern.
parent_context: A patterned floor slab inside the café (`21319 - Central Perk.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Use it for floors, signs or inlays where the stud grid is too coarse. Alternate plate colours in each course to draw the pattern.
